title: Wolves Livestock Predation Survival Analytics
author: Francisco Santiago-Ávila
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j2rcqd6

steps.title: Initialize Stata Environment
steps.instruction: Set up the workspace and load the dataset.

substeps.instruction: Clear all existing data and memory
Change directory to the file location
Start a log file named 'Name.smcl' (replacing any existing file)
Set memory to 1g
Load 'Data.dta' replacing existing data
Set 'more off' permanently

steps.title: Clean Intervention Variables
steps.instruction: Update intervention type and dummy variables based on wolf kill counts.

substeps.instruction: Replace 'Interv_dich' with 'non-lethal' if 'wolves_killed' equals 0
Replace 'Interv_dummy' with 0 if 'Interv_dich' is 'non-lethal'

steps.title: Configure Survival Time Data
steps.instruction: Set the data as survival time for the PWP-GT model using the stset command.

substeps.instruction: Execute stset using 'Delay_in_yrstop_time' as the time variable, 'status_event' as the failure variable, 'time .' as the exit, and 'start_time' as the entry
List variables: ID_TRS_yr, _t0, _t, _d, and _st
Run 'stdescribe' and 'stsum' to summarize the survival data

steps.title: Analyze Specific Strata
steps.instruction: Perform survival analysis on a filtered dataset containing only records with sufficient observations per strata.

substeps.instruction: Load 'Data_Strata#.dta'
Re-run stset with 'Delay_in_yrstop_time', failure('status_event'), exit('time .'), and enter('start_time')
Run 'stdescribe' and 'stsum'

steps.title: Compare Survival Functions
steps.instruction: Evaluate and visualize survival functions grouped by intervention type ('Interv_dich').

substeps.instruction: List survival functions by group and compare them
Graph survival functions by group
Graph survival functions including failures by group
Graph smoothed hazard estimates (hazard ratio) by group
Graph cumulative hazard by group
Perform a Log-rank test to test equality of survival functions by 'Interv_dich'
Perform a Log-rank test by 'Interv_dich' stratified by 'yr_stratum'

steps.title: Execute Cox Proportional Hazards Models
steps.instruction: Run stratified Cox models to analyze the effect of intervention and year.

substeps.instruction: Run stcox for 'Interv_dummy' and 'year', stratified by 'yr_stratum' with cluster robust standard errors (vce) by 'ID_TRS_yr'
Run the same stcox model with the 'nohr' option

steps.title: Verify Proportional Hazard Assumptions
steps.instruction: Test the proportional hazards assumption for the model covariates.

substeps.instruction: Run 'estat phtest, log detail'
Run 'estat phtest' and 'stphplot' for 'Interv_dummy'
Run 'estat phtest' and 'stphplot' for 'year'

steps.title: Adjust for Assumption Violations
steps.instruction: Apply a time-varying covariate if the proportional hazard assumption is violated.

substeps.instruction: Run stcox for 'Interv_dummy' and 'year', adding a time-varying covariate 'tvc(Interv_dummy)' with 'texp(_t)', stratified by 'yr_stratum' and clustered by 'ID_TRS_yr'
Run 'strmcure' for 'Interv_dummy' and 'year', with shared frailty 'shared(ID_TRS_yr)' and stratified by 'yr_stratum'

steps.title: Analyze Correlation for Lethal Interventions
steps.instruction: Calculate the correlation between the delay between incidents and the number of wolves killed for lethal interventions only.

substeps.instruction: Perform a Spearman correlation between 'Delay_in_yrstop_time' and 'wolves_killed' where 'Interv_dich' equals 'Lethal'

steps.title: Finalize Session
steps.instruction: Close the log file and end the session.

substeps.instruction: Close the log file 'Sample .DO FILE'
